tool_args.rationale: All five pilot responses are positive and lie at H=0.16–0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether adaptation overtakes the sink-modulated fast response near the target H=20 and helps separate the adaptation amplitude from its timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mostly constrains the ratio of adaptation amplitude to its time constant. Fitting the five pilot rows would not reliably determine the response at H=20.
Finer trajectory sampling does not directly test the long-horizon reversal.
This omits the observed sink-gradient dependence and still leaves the slow timescale poorly constrained.
